review.why: Outlines how to build paid-ad concepts and copy decks from a validated brand profile, keeping facts apart from hypotheses.
review.summary: Seven-step outline: load the validated brand profile, objective, audience, offer and proof; separate facts, approved claims and hypotheses; flag cold-start Meta accounts; generate materially distinct concepts with insight, promise, proof, hook, CTA and test; check copy against platform spec files; return a versioned brief and copy deck.
strengths: Concepts must be strategically distinct, not cosmetic rewrites
Never invents testimonials, scarcity, prices or outcomes
States that human review is needed before launch
cautions: Only an outline: no templates, examples or output format
Depends on a brand profile, audit evidence and platform spec files from the rest of its suite
Meta cold-start rules point to another skill not included
